query:
SELECT fl.*, rs.name 
FROM fetchLogs fl 
JOIN rssSources rs ON fl.sourceId = rs.id 
WHERE rs.name LIKE '%كومبس%' 
ORDER BY fl.fetchedAt DESC 
LIMIT 5;
